name: Generative UI
summary: Instead of only text, the agent's output is rendered as interface components. Typically the model calls a tool, and the client maps that tool's input and result to a component such as a weather card, form or chart; declarative protocols like A2UI and MCP Apps standardize the same idea across hosts.
how: Define tools whose results describe UI data
Let the model choose a tool during the conversation
Map each tool part to a component by tool name
Show loading, result and error states as the tool runs
facts: AI SDK UI tool parts, assistant-ui tool UI
Richer answers, but more components to build and maintain
goodFor: Structured results like charts, cards and forms
Letting users act on results with clicks
watchOut: Every component must be designed and tested
Does not carry over to text-only channels
